notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {0} if it's the first equip ability you've activated this turn, or {2} otherwise, attaching it to the attacking creature, and causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Repeat each turn.
